## Smart widgets for your website. Fouita is like your sales wingman! It's this cool tool that helps businesses make eye-catching widgets. Think of it as a marketing wizard – turning curious visitors into happy customers and giving sales a high-five! # Fouita Reviews. ### The community submitted 5 reviews to tell us what they like about Fouita, what Fouita can do better, and more. Tines Build agents & automations integrated across your workspace. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a founder review for Fouita. Been using Fouita for over a year, using their various tools, like social media embeds, music players, before and after image sliders and more on my websites with flawless integration and uptime. Very happy with Fouita and their developments. Highly recommend them if you're after extensive and customisable solutions for your website. Fouita is a user-friendly platform that offers a wide range of widgets. The founder frequently releases new widgets, including an all-in-one review widget that has been a game changer for my client's restaurant websites. Abdelhay offers quick support tailored to specific needs. The review widgets do not slow down the website and provide excellent analytics on the dashboard. The Fouita platform is an excellent tool that can be utilized on any website. When I first got this, I will admit I got it because it was cheap but looked like it had potential. But after using it for about 6 months, it is one of the most clever tools I've found. If I need to do something "quick and dirty" to roll out a website component, this has all the tools built in to do it in about 5 minutes. So it literally saves me hours of effort each month. I'm not a web programmer, so it's important for me as a web designer to have a tool at hand where I can add widgets to the site to fill in missing features or options. Fouit is a simple and functional tool that helps me to make websites more beautiful without unnecessary complexity, not only for me but also for my clients, without having to go to their website. Thank you very much for your work.
